```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Draft-eligible seasons from 2019 through the last complete season, one team
# per player-season. The draft label is an outcome, joined on, never a column of
# the playing-time table.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
outcomes <- collect(tbl(con, "outcomes"))
labelled <- drafted_stat_line(usage, outcomes, seasons = 2019:complete_through) |>
  filter(position_group %in% names(position_palette()))

by_pos <- labelled |>
  group_by(position_group, drafted) |>
  summarise(
    player_seasons = n(),
    mean_share = mean(appearance_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    grp = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"),
    tip = paste0(
      position_group,
      ", ",
      grp,
      ": a line in ",
      scales::percent(mean_share, accuracy = 1),
      " of team games, over ",
      fmt(player_seasons),
      " player-seasons"
    )
  )

p <- by_pos |>
  ggplot(aes(
    mean_share,
    reorder(as.character(position_group), mean_share),
    fill = grp
  )) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Drafted = "#1B9E77", `Not drafted` = "#7570B3")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Do drafted players show up in the box score more often?",
    subtitle = "Average share of a team's games with a stat line, drafted against not drafted",
    x = "Average share of team games with a stat line",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "drafted-stat-line-share", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: group-table
# The overall comparison the bars cannot show: how many player-seasons there
# are and how many logged a line in any game.
labelled |>
  group_by(drafted) |>
  summarise(
    player_seasons = n(),
    any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0),
    mean_share = mean(appearance_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Group = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"),
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(player_seasons),
    `Logged a stat line in any game` = scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 0.1),
    `Average share of team games with a line` = scales::percent(mean_share, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Group",
      "Player-seasons",
      "Logged a stat line in any game",
      "Average share of team games with a line"
    ),
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Draft-eligible rostered player-seasons from 2019 through the season ",
      complete_through,
      ", one team per player-season."
    )
  )
```
